features: fixed cube, indoor, CS-mount interchangeable lens, manual focus
no day/night switching -- no mechanical IR cut filter, always color
server-based analytics available (line counting, people counting, face detection, smoke detection, heat map, dwell time, people queue -- requires external IVS/ALPR server)
detection range: detect 72m, observe 29m, recognize 14.4m, identify 7.2m
ONVIF Compliant: Profile S, Profile G, Profile T, Profile Q; edge recording via ONVIF Profile G or proprietary protocol
GB28181 compliant, standard IoT security (anti-hacking, anti-malware)
built-in microphone + 3.5mm phone jack audio interface

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. RTSP port is 7070 by default.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'ACTi' profile. Default RTSP port is 7070.
